violation_type.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child
violation_type.typical_finding: The buses didn't have the children's emergency telephone numbers, the only information was the parents contact number and email address.

finding_variants.text: The buses didn't have the children's emergency telephone numbers, the only information was the parents contact number and email address.
